title: family_relay
description: Hub -> integration push session only. Forward message (a ws/server family_* message, kids_request_state for a child device, or an early access message access_request_update / access_requests / access_request_error for a recipient device) to the HA WebSocket subscriptions (<ns>/family/subscribe) of the HA users of these devices that are not connected to the hub but have remote access. Fire-and-forget; when nobody is subscribed the integration drops it. The integration never stores it.
